meta.title: D&D Combat Tracker — the all-in-one DM companion for D&D 5e
meta.description: Everything a D&D Dungeon Master needs in one window: initiative tracker, battle map, hero sheets, scenario editor, scene show, music and an AI assistant. No extra apps — build your own campaign or start from a ready-made D&D 5e template.
meta.keywords: D&D, DnD, D&D 5e, Dungeons & Dragons, DM tools, Dungeon Master companion, initiative tracker, combat tracker, virtual tabletop, VTT, online character sheet, campaign manager, battle map, encounter manager

hero.eyebrow: The all-in-one DM companion for D&D 5e
hero.text: Initiative, dice, hit points, conditions, map, music and story are calculated and synced for you — on the DM screen and on every player's phone. No extra apps or services.
hero.note: Free · sign in with Google · browser and phone

tools.q: Do I need other apps to run a game?
tools.a: No. The initiative tracker, battle map, hero sheets, scenario, scene show, music and AI assistant all work in one browser window — no Discord bots, spreadsheets or separate VTTs.

editions.a: Right now — D&D campaigns with Heroes of Might and Magic V-style mechanics. The campaign builder is getting the full D&D 5e rules (2014 and 2024): conditions, saving throws, classes and multiclassing, and custom rules can be tuned to any edition or house rules.

world.q: Can I create my own world?
world.a: Yes. Races, spells, creatures, artifacts, skills and rules are edited without code — separately in each campaign. You can start from an empty world or copy a template.

players.a: Just a phone or a laptop with a browser. A player signs in with Google, enters the invite code — and sees their hero, the battle turn and the scene slides.

price.a: The platform is free for now. The AI assistant runs on your own Claude, OpenAI or Gemini key.
